Overview

Ibagué is a city in TO with a population of 550,000. Colombia’s music capital, set in the Andes with a pleasant climate and strong cultural traditions. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
